Jordanelle Reservoir stocked with rainbow trout, brown trout, smallmouth bass, yellow perch

services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: Jordanelle Rentals operates the exclusive marina on the reservoir and offers jet ski rentals from our location within Jordanelle State Park - a 15-minute drive from Park City, Midway, and Heber City, and 45 minutes from Salt Lake City. We run an all Sea-Doo fleet, well-maintained for your safety and with plenty of power to tear it up on the reservoir. No cancellations inside of 7 days without penalty. Same-day cancellations and no-shows are void from any kind of refund. services.name: Fishing Boats
services.desc: Known for the trophy-sized smallmouth bass stocked in its waters, Jordanelle Reservoir opened for public fishing in 1995. Located conveniently between Park City and Heber City, local anglers can wet their first fly after just a short drive. The reservoir is also home to brown trout, rainbow trout, walleye, and yellow perch. These are basic, open aluminum boats - they get you out on the water and that's it. No fish finder or electronics, no rod holders, and no rods, tackle, or bait provided. No cancellations inside of 7 days without penalty. quotes.text: I had a very excellent experience with my first ever time renting. I was very confused at first where the rentals were but a woman named Valerie was very thoughtful and welcoming.
The folks at the Jordanelle Rentals and Marina were so professional and fast! Our favorite employee was Madden, who got us set up with a Crest pontoon boat.
Had a fun time with Kent as captain of our boat. Gave us great instructions — very professional, patient, passionate, and very funny.
The people at the rental for jet skis were so helpful and had a great attitude as we were renting 4 jet skis at once!!!
We had an issue with our rental reservation and Paige was amazing at helping us resolve it. She went above and beyond.
Jack and Nate are the best! Always willing to do anything to help. Jack and Nate treat my boat like it is their own.
